text: What counts as success for your goal?
On a scale of 1 to 5 (1 = not at all, 5 = very), how frustrating is this task so far?
What, if anything, about this task feels difficult or unclear?
Is anything getting in the way of making progress right now? If so, what?
Is there anything you’d want to do here but can’t? Why not?
Is there anything you would do here if you were able to? What’s stopping you?
